purpose: Distinguish true moderate illumination response from transient post-motion input excess using an independent physical-light observation, and validate an identity-output diagnostic on the actual native bridge. Numerical confidence alone does not identify cause.

deployment_boundary.provisional_note: Export provisional_gain as a diagnostic only. CPU falsifiers reject it as a causal correction. Any future nonidentity adapter needs a new local acceptance decision and a versioned independent-observation contract; this request does not authorize connecting provisional gain to RR.
deployment_boundary.production_changes_owner: job08 after dependency and local acceptance gates
deployment_boundary.protected_settings: Keep the user's D16/S256 radiance scales, G2/G3, RR Fallback, Diffuse RR and Reflection History enabled; NZR Temporal disabled. Anchor/ColourTrack/PostFlick remain OFF in the recommended preset. Any legacy Anchor ON run below is an isolated known-bad control, not a preset change.
deployment_boundary.additional_observable_cost: An independent high-sample same-pose reference may be available only for research and may be unaffordable in production. Its first purpose is to distinguish hypotheses, not to imply a shippable runtime witness.

conditions.intervention: Record an actual unlooped camera-motion bout ending at relative frame0 at the chosen target pose, while engine illumination is held constant by an independently documented scene control.
conditions.truth_requirement: Measure expected physical target-pose D/S level independently; do not assume a late noisy input or selected RR image is truth.

conditions.intervention: Repeat the matched camera trajectory and target pose, changing a real engine light parameter to its documented 1.25 setting at relative frame0. Hold that setting through frame31. Match world/geometry/time state where controllable and record mismatches.
conditions.truth_requirement: Record the independent realized physical-light ratio and uncertainty. A nominal engine parameter multiplier is not proof that every D/S pixel changes by exactly1.25; global illumination, exposure and nonlinear engine behavior must be measured.

initial_minimal_experiment.why_this_pair: The camera prelude is matched; only the genuine light intervention differs. The independent same-pose reference reveals how much observed current/ref change is real lighting. It can falsify a claimed classifier without pretending that the packaged tensors already contain this information.
initial_minimal_experiment.actual_engine_control_api_reason: No game/engine light-control or high-sample rendering API is promised by the handoff. Document the local mechanism if available; otherwise return this as the precise missing observable.

relative_export_frames.bucket_alignment: Early k0..5 and late k6..25 are native motion-window indices, not assumed capture-relative indices. The frame lists above assume observed onset k0 at relative0; derive actual buckets and the first inactive frame from logged k/active flags. Native k25 remains active; when aligned, post-window begins at relative26. If the schedule is not aligned or rearms, report that mapping and do not silently relabel frames.

initial_minimal_experiment.absolute_frame_ids_reason: This is a new controlled scene experiment. Map every relative frame to its actual capture ordinal and provider frameIndex in the returned manifest; do not renumber or invent capture IDs.
initial_minimal_experiment.prehistory_policy: Retain locally every real chronological input and actual native/RR state from the true context reset through the window. Record the actual available history length. Prewarm by those original frames once, not by looping the exported window or fabricating a converged ring. If history is incomplete, explicitly label startup-invalid regions and restrict conclusions.
initial_minimal_experiment.schedule_policy: Use the actual native BuildFrame schedule: six physical slots, settled2, sample4, motion1deg, arm3deg, window25. Log the measured motion and ring validity/ages; do not force an armed window while claiming ordinary same-pose native behavior. Keep the matched prelude long enough to satisfy observed state requirements, recording its actual length rather than assuming a magic warmup count.

extension_controls_after_initial_observa.both_directions: Run actual engine transitions1->a and a->1 for every listed multiplier; record realized physical D/S response and uncertainty, including local spatial variation. Include1/a estimates only when the measured reference supports that interpretation.
scenes: same pose with a genuine step during an already armed post-motion window
same pose with no preceding arm: verify ordinary host inactivity rather than forcing gain evaluation
genuine illumination step while camera motion is still active
constant-light stationary independent-noise control where independent samples actually exist
spatially coherent and temporally persistent residual controls; do not assume neighboring samples independent
local moving object against a static background whose true illumination changes
new-view/disocclusion and sparse/unbalanced recall support, retaining the original baseline masks
camera cut, reset, enable/disable, cancelled recording, and odd-size or resolution-change cases
native physical dark/FP16/16.16 threshold and finite-cap16 numerical controls
extension_controls_after_initial_observa.synthetic_interventions_separate: Multiplying saved tensors is permitted only as a labeled arithmetic/plumbing control, never as evidence of a genuine light change. Do not upload a catalogue of repeated frames as independent captured samples.

If original per-frame source bytes differ between paired runs, record that and use it as an uncertainty/confound rather than claiming exact equality.

protocol: Run OFF and the unchanged LEGACY_NATIVE control on a locally available known active unlooped native case; an actual nonidentity legacy gain must be observed before claiming the canary is discriminating.

Attest actual Configure settings, active/refresh flags, resource identities, GPU frame/fence ownership, executed CSO hashes and real provider binding IDs. The provider's anchor-disabling debug option must be false; this is separate from enabling the D3D12 debug layer.

Record original physical source D/S, private post-Apply D/S, the resources bound before provider radiance scaling, and the restored physical resources. Verify original G3 inputs are unchanged and RR/NZR consume the intended owned copies.
Apply a forced-OFF mutation in this isolated harness and require the expected legacy correction/routing assertion to fail. Record the failure; it is a canary rejection, not a candidate quality win.

Run DIAGNOSTIC_V1 separately: actual bound gain is identity and physical D/S must match the original within the existing finite-radiance sanitizer contract, while diagnostics and key refresh are demonstrably executed. A hidden provisional-gain binding is a hard failure.

native_units_and_abi.physical_level: dot(diffuse.rgb,[0.2126,0.7152,0.0722]) + dot(specular.rgb,same weights), before provider scaling
native_units_and_abi.stats_sampling: four bilinear taps per8x8 cell, not a64-texel mean
native_units_and_abi.global_sums_scope: actual full native dispatch grid, not the exported crop; export dispatch extent and valid count. Never compare a crop-only sum with full-frame counters as if they shared a denominator.
native_units_and_abi.ratio_provenance: Original integer sums permit exact integer ratio computation and reproduction of native split-word FP32 conversion; stored-FP16 reconstruction remains a bounded estimate. Export both labels separately.
native_units_and_abi.alpha_contract: Both input lobe alpha planes remain bitwise unchanged through private copies and Apply. Do not reinterpret/filter them as colour.

candidate_constants.diagnostic_rounding_envelope: FP16 RTNE/RTZ union plus declared FP32 slack; deterministic dispersion envelope, not a calibrated statistical confidence interval

capture_and_export.new_scene_render_extent_reason: Unknown until local capture; preserve actual render/allocation extents in metadata rather than assuming1505x847.
capture_and_export.new_scene_crop_origin_reason: Choose from unmodified BASE before any candidate inspection, aligned to8 pixels and fully inside actual input extents. Record every frame's origin; if the crop tracks motion, subtract the previous origin in correspondence.
capture_and_export.halo_reason: Contains the step3 cell neighborhood and Apply interpolation around the128 core. Native recall/RR still execute on complete local inputs; the crop halo does not replace full-frame history or certify reprojection outside it.
capture_and_export.source_gpu_row_pitch_reason: Record actual D3D12 resource/readback footprints locally. Export tight arrays after stripping recorded row padding; never guess a GPU row pitch from width.
capture_and_export.export_byte_order: little-endian, C-order; NPZ allow_pickle=False; lossless compression permitted

capture_and_export.constants_and_metadata: Export exact Stats864-byte, Gain80-byte and Apply16-byte constant buffers for enabled variants; original46-word provider controls, camera/projection/position words, render/allocation extents, per-frame crop origin, source ordinal, frameIndex, timestamps/delta time, reset/active/refresh flags, ring validity/age/physical-slice metadata, settings, resource IDs, source/CSO hashes, device/driver/provider version and readback stride. Raw six-slice textures are not needed for this conditional estimator task.
capture_and_export.fixed_masks: Build all analysis masks and denominators from unmodified BASE/source observations before candidate inspection, hash them and reuse exactly across variants. Report missing/new-view support explicitly. A grid static mask must not be relabeled a full-resolution moving-object guarantee. Do not crop or rescale image comparison panels differently by variant.
capture_and_export.full_histories: Complete full-frame inputs, albedo and provider state remain local for genuine native/RR replay; upload only the specified crop/summary subset. Cropped arrays alone are not an executable full RR dispatch.

independent_physical_reference.share_only_if_proven_identical: The first and third reference may share data only if camera, geometry, actual light state, engine time and relevant renderer state are independently shown equivalent. Do not assume equivalence merely because the camera looks similar.
independent_physical_reference.uncertainty_contract: Supply the estimator, confidence/coverage target, independence assumptions, effective sample-count treatment for correlation and stopping criterion. Report unresolved/unsupported pixels. Do not label raw repeated temporal frames independent or divide variance by sample count without justification. If a defensible uncertainty interval is unavailable, leave it unavailable and the causal gate remains blocked.
independent_physical_reference.reference_production_method_reason: Actual engine access, sample accumulation, independent seeds and converged same-pose rendering capability are unknown. Accept only a documented physically equivalent independent reference; do not fabricate an engine control or treat late input/RR as truth.
independent_physical_reference.raw_reference_replicates: Keep locally with hashes and exact generation metadata; upload the above summaries first, not every high-sample render.

startup_reset_order_and_lifetime_checks: Replay original frame order once with actual per-variant reset/warmup; record incomplete prehistory. Never loop a short crop or reuse a future frame as past history.
Reset on actual camera cut/context replacement/discontinuity; verify the first invalid-history frame abstains and stale keys are not read.
Preserve old-key recall before new-key refresh, all six physical slots, native32-byte sums clearing, Stats-to-Gain UAV ordering and key/gain state transitions.
Run D3D12 debug layer/GPU validation where locally available and report actual error/warning counts. Enabling it must not activate the provider debug mode that bypasses native Anchor.
Check owned private D/S descriptors/resources/constant uploads remain alive through fences, cancellation abandons the physical graph, and shared family budget is charged correctly.
Verify nonidentity legacy interpolation leakage separately from diagnostic identity. Do not fix transport inside this estimator experiment.

compiler_request.requirements: Convert source-shaped diagnostic pseudocode into the separately reviewed adapter; compile fresh CSO and matching header together, record compiler/source/bytecode hashes and warnings. Existing generated bytes are not a build of this candidate.

tolerances_and_falsifiers.identity_physical_rgb: Require bitwise equality on finite nonnegative inputs within the unchanged sanitizer domain before provider scaling. Classify out-of-domain sanitizer behavior separately; do not hide it in a loose image tolerance.

provisional_fp16_gain_away_from_branches.rationale: initial arithmetic parity allowance only; no acceptance of a different strict-guard decision

tolerances_and_falsifiers.strict_branches: Quantization/rounding intervals must propagate through both endpoints. Uncertain branch support abstains. Exact native counters must lie within the claimed locally computed full-grid bounds, with documented FP32 conversion slack.
tolerances_and_falsifiers.fresh_rr_repeatability_reason: Measure actual OFF-vs-OFF native provider repeatability on this device/context first. Use that baseline and identical physical inputs to assess DIAGNOSTIC_V1; do not invent deterministic equality or a universal pixel tolerance.
tolerances_and_falsifiers.true_light_response_reason: Use independent physical-reference uncertainty plus measured native OFF repeatability. An identity diagnostic must add no measurable attenuation or latency relative to OFF; unresolved uncertainty cannot certify a future nonidentity gain.

performance_and_memory.scope: Measure actual full-resolution native Stats, Gain, Apply, provider and total path separately for inactive, refresh and active frames. Interleave OFF/sham/legacy/diagnostic runs, retain paired GPU timestamps and report median/p90 plus observed repeatability. Keep capture readback/instrumentation cost separate.
performance_and_memory.allocation_scope: Record owned textures, private full-resolution D/S copies, key ring, auxiliary upload/descriptor/readback buffers and shared-family budget. Resident VRAM and opaque provider cost remain null if unmeasured; do not extrapolate192x192 export cost to full game cost.
performance_and_memory.sample_count_reason: Choose sufficient actual local repeated timing observations to resolve observed jitter; report count and stopping rationale, not fabricated cloud performance.

uncompressed_initial_upload_budget.assumptions: Two source sequences x40 frames, halo192x192, core128x128, three fresh-RR variants, two enabled native variants, five physical-copy snapshots per sequence/variant, three independent physical-reference snapshots. This is an upper bound: omit bit-identical duplicates only with referenced hashes. Raw full-frame histories and reference replicates remain local.
uncompressed_initial_upload_budget.stop_rule: Send the initial pair and summary first. Keep extension controls/full captures local; upload only the first new discriminating counterexample within the remaining allowance or request a separate surgical addition. Compression may reduce transfer size but does not change this uncompressed accounting.
